bio: This restaurant in a fabulous countryside location boasts a delightful garden and terrace. Inside, the decor is a winning blend of tradition and modernity. The Meier family also runs the gorgeous HILZHOF, a hotel with chic guestrooms, and the compact fine dining restaurant HIO. At MEIER, the really delicious cuisine perfectly reflects a house motto that translates as the field cooks. They make use of organic produce sourced from the region or even from their own vegetable field or herb garden. Culinary pleasure and sustainability go hand in hand here. Charming front-of-house team....
